dogecoin.text:
**ATTENTION #dogecoin HOLDERS**

For those of you figuring out when to possibly sell during the SNL broadcast (if Elon says anything), keep this in mind. The west coast airs SNL 3 hours after the east coast. So….if it’s mentioned, how long will the peak last? Just wondering….

Remember, Saturday Night Live plays in different time zones throughout the evening. This is new territory and nobody can predict when the pumps and dumps will occur. On that note, I wish everyone the best. It’s exciting! #dogecoin
I’m not surprised at the lack of movement for Dogecoin after the Coinbase listing. Are you?
